data.description:
## Why
Under option A (Atin, 2026-10-01) signing and notarization stay in GitHub Actions, and no credentials go to Atlas. Three 1.0 proofs need real signed builds before release: C11-307 (Sparkle update installs on macOS 26), C11-298 (a second copy does not kill the running app, across an update/relaunch), and C11-292/293 (Atin approves the exact signed bytes before they are published). Today `.github/workflows/release.yml` signs, notarizes and publishes in one job (lines ~254-341), so there is no way to get signed bytes without publishing. Astra plan audit must-fix 7 (`upstream-triage/c11-1.0/plan-audit-astra.md`); split out of C11-293 to break the C11-307 → C11-292 → C11-293 cycle.

## Scope
In: a GitHub Actions path that builds, signs and notarizes a c11 app/DMG from a named ref and uploads it only as a workflow artifact (never a GitHub release, never `latest`, never the appcast), with SHA-256 hashes in the run summary; an optional Sparkle-signed test appcast pointing at that artifact for update proofs, kept off the production feed; retrieval instructions for Atlas. Out: publishing, changes to the production release job's behavior, any credential on Atlas or in the repo.

## Acceptance criteria
1. A workflow_dispatch run on a branch head produces a notarized, stapled DMG as a workflow artifact plus its SHA-256, and creates no release, tag or appcast change (`gh api repos/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/releases/latest` unchanged before/after).
2. Atlas downloads that artifact and `spctl -a -vv` / `stapler validate` accept it; C11-307's update proof and C11-298's relaunch proof consume it.
3. The final 1.0 candidate is produced by the same path, and its hashes are what Atin approves; C11-293 publishes those exact bytes (or a byte-identical re-staple is proven).
4. Secrets are read only inside the existing GitHub environment; nothing is echoed to logs.

Size: S-M. Tier: P1. Owner seat: atlas (owns C11-292/293). Doctrine: CI-only, no tenant config, no credentials leave GitHub.

# C11-312 review validation

Draft PR: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/503

Fetched origin/main: 7bb785741750ddeb8ab12b4cf6472593fb8c3550
Merge base: 0ff8887e5e965400b01645ef40b85fd0b2605cf2

## Delivered behavior

Manual-only Actions producer checks a named source against a required full SHA, builds/signs/notarizes/staples the app and DMG, stages a Sparkle-signed appcast and four daemon binaries/checksums/manifest, and uploads exactly ten files including SHA256SUMS and signing-manifest.json. Proof apps use an isolated bundle/feed/build and HTTP ATS allowance before signing; candidates retain the production bundle/build/feed/ATS and require the version to match their target tag. Repository permission is contents:read. Production release.yml is unchanged. No publishing workflow was dispatched; no owner merge/release, Atlas credential provisioning, installed-skill edits/sync, Hyperion native build or app launch occurred.

The temporary exact-branch push trigger and all push-only input defaults are removed at the review head. Real proof source/producer SHAs below are distinct from the review SHA. From the second proof SHA to the review SHA, only dispatch wiring changed; signing helpers, artifact layout and toolchain are identical.

## Targeted checks

Ten synthetic producer tests passed locally in 24.903 seconds, using fake platform executables, synthetic source/artifacts and secret canaries. They exercise proof/candidate identity and ATS, source-SHA mismatch before tools, production-feed rejection, wrong candidate version/tag, missing secret, signer/notary/stapler failures, cleanup, exact upload allowlist/no canary exposure and tamper/unexpected-file rejection. They are not native Apple signing or Atlas runtime proof. Final-head workflow-guard-tests reran these successfully in CI. Final-head remote-daemon-tests and web-typecheck also passed. Actionlint 1.7.12, bash -n and git diff --check passed.

Final-head CI build, workflow-guard-tests, remote-daemon-tests and web-typecheck passed (run 36970604097). Compatibility (36970604320) is running and GhosttyKit (36970604138) is queued at the final evidence snapshot; Drawbridge checks are skipped for the draft. Review may begin while these run under updated go-owner rules; Merge Captain must require green exact-head checks before landing. Intermediate native CI at 50dfe3ed5059162e88fe1e93db9a3dd130628e81 was green. CI build compiles the app; this owner has not claimed execution of native logic XCTest or Atlas consumer behavior.

## Publication-state observation

Before the first proof, latest was v0.67.0 (release id 400865310); production appcast asset id 603012785, content SHA-256 ce5fa631f2bc6f14993a64381b110ca19b60da7227ab51f64176440b67a40673. After proof 3, every stable release/asset identity, content digest and tag ref/SHA matched the snapshots. Raw API JSON differed only in appcast download_count (226 to 253). This is unchanged publication/content state, not byte-identical API JSON. After proof 4, latest and all tag refs/SHAs still match. A like-for-like sample of the latest 50 releases confirms all release/asset identities and digests unchanged. Production appcast download_count is now 258; content digest/id are unchanged. An initial 30-item default release query was corrected to the same 50-item page size as the before snapshot; it was a query-length difference, not a publication change.

## Validator scenario

1. On an authorized client, download the two named proof artifacts from the exact runs above into fresh directories. Verify SHA256SUMS and sign_artifact.py verify; compare all nine hashes against the trusted run summary. Expected: ten files each, both source/workflow SHAs match this evidence, proof builds 3 then 4, isolated bundle/feed, no private key/certificate/keychain. Copy verified bytes to Atlas; no signing credentials or new GitHub credential are needed there.
2. On Atlas, validate each DMG staple, mount readonly, validate the contained app staple and run codesign --verify --deep --strict and spctl -a -vv --type execute. Expected: acceptance of both artifacts and the recorded proof identities. Record commands/results on C11-307/C11-298; Actions success is not this Atlas Gatekeeper observation.
3. Serve all eight build-3 assets plus synthetic notes.html from http://127.0.0.1:18731/proof on Atlas with a fixture-owned bounded server. Preserve the installed build-3 app, replace the served directory with verified build-4 assets, and run the C11-307 updater and C11-298 second-copy/relaunch scenarios. Expected: fetch/install/relaunch build 4 through the signed isolated feed, with no production feed write or unrelated fleet termination. For computer use enumerate displays, bound the run and prove dismissal; tear down only fixture-owned resources. These runtime checks remain consumer-owned and are unperformed by this CI-only seat.
4. After reviewed 1.0.0 source exists, dispatch purpose=candidate with its full expected SHA and target_tag=v1.0.0, leaving proof inputs empty. Expected: production bundle/build/feed/ATS, versioned candidate appcast, complete eight-asset immutable set and nine recorded hashes. C11-292 gets Atin's named run/hash approval; C11-293 publishes those preserved bytes without rebuild/re-sign/re-staple/regeneration. The final candidate and approval/publication are future consumer work, not producer proof performed here.

# C11-312 review, cycle 1

Verdict: **PASS** for the artifact-only producer at `c5475780903dd0bd4682a824e6db9edd82a283eb`.

PR: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/503
Base: `0ff8887e5e965400b01645ef40b85fd0b2605cf2` (merge-base with freshly fetched origin/main `7bb785741750ddeb8ab12b4cf6472593fb8c3550`). Remote head and main were rechecked before closeout and remain unchanged. Reviewed all six changed files and the unchanged build, signing, appcast, daemon, and release seams. No local builds, test execution, or app launches.

## Blocking

None found.

## Non-blocking

None requiring a code change in this pass.

## Evidence and boundaries

- `.github/workflows/sign-artifact.yml:3-36`: only manual dispatch remains; the canonical-repository guard prevents fork execution. No PR, pull_request_target, or push trigger at the reviewed head. Dispatch inputs enter environment variables or checkout inputs, not interpolated shell code. This path intentionally requires an authorized operator to admit the reviewed source.
- `.github/workflows/sign-artifact.yml:30-32,96-138`: repository token is contents:read; Apple/Sparkle secrets are scoped to the signing step in the signing job. Artifact upload is an explicit ten-file allowlist. No release/tag/Homebrew/latest/feed publication operation exists in the reviewed producer or invoked helpers. `release.yml` has zero diff from base.
- `scripts/sign-artifact.sh:3-20,39-60`: tracing is disabled; certificate import uses an ephemeral keychain, restrictive file permissions, an EXIT cleanup trap, and the workflow's separate always() cleanup. Upload paths and Go caches exclude keychain/certificate/private-key material. Missing credentials and signing/notary failures stop before upload. No secret-printing path found in the reviewed helper chain.
- `scripts/sign_artifact.py:32-111,122-179`: expected full source SHA and recursive submodule pins are checked; producer workflow identity is recorded separately. Proof identity/feed/ATS overrides precede signing. Candidate version/tag and production identity are checked. Final hashes are computed after stapling/appcast generation, with no later asset mutation before upload.
- Independently inspected successful [proof run 36969530633](https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/actions/runs/36969530633), including successful cleanup. Its logs show both staple and validate operations succeeded and app Gatekeeper reported Notarized Developer ID. The shell requires Accepted notarization status for both app and DMG before those operations. Source and producer were `8529f38cb6b9a711acc589d75f699863f0313a79`, not the review SHA. The complete delta to the review SHA only removes the bootstrap push trigger and push-input fallbacks; signing helpers and toolchain are identical.
- Independently downloaded artifact `c11-signed-proof-8529f38cb6b9-36969530633-1` (id `11212235303`) and hashed its archive and all nine files listed in SHA256SUMS. All match validation comment `ev_01M3XK9WN8T2F809SF3E264WFS`. Exactly ten archive entries. Archive SHA-256: `58173fb5686e4a19a1e7beb5f9c119881f82ca92d9a33f8750f1d8db840014e2`. DMG SHA-256: `99c0213a9d8d3f930fa804f118dfae5e06879cea708a09bb32ec56e297ce6ca8`. Manifest records proof build 4, isolated bundle/feed, full source/workflow identities, submodules, Xcode 16.4 and Zig 0.15.2. The actual appcast names build 4 and the isolated loopback DMG URL.
- GitHub also confirms [proof run 36965144163](https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/actions/runs/36965144163) succeeded. Its build-3 file hashes and before/after publication comparison remain owner-provided evidence, not independently repeated historical observations. Current latest release and production appcast identity/digest match that evidence.

## Runtime proof still required

- Merge Captain must require green exact-head checks before landing. At closeout, CI build, compatibility, workflow-guard-tests (including the ten behavioral synthetic producer tests), daemon tests, and web typecheck passed; GhosttyKit remained pending. PASS is a code-review verdict, not an all-green merge authorization.
- On Atlas, C11-307/C11-298 must verify the downloaded DMGs and contained apps with stapler, codesign, and Gatekeeper, then prove the real build-3 to build-4 update and second-copy/relaunch behavior. Neither this review nor the CI signing run proves those consumer paths. The approved plan assigns them to the consuming tickets; they do not block landing this producer. No signing credentials go to Atlas.
- Both observed signing runs used the temporary branch bootstrap trigger. A final-head workflow_dispatch run has not been observed; validate manual dispatch after the workflow is available on the default branch. The authorized bootstrap proof and reviewed trigger-only delta support this producer review without claiming exact-head execution.
- A final versioned 1.0.0 candidate, named-byte approval, and unchanged-byte promotion remain C11-292/C11-293 work. No production publication is approved by this verdict.
